# Free Power Armor Promo Skin: Heat Eater (Doritos/Rockstar/Microsoft)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_74_nukaknights-post-pa-skin-heat-eater-wärmeopfer.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### Since yesterday there is a promo campaign from Doritos, Rockstar energy Drink and Microsoft. Among other things, you can unlock a PA skin called “Heat Eater”.

The skin is listed under "International" Doritos In-Game Content. With a code it is also possible in Germany to activate it here.

https://news.xbox.com/.../doritos-rockstar-xbox-game.../

Reddit thread with codes and instructions: https://www.reddit.com/r/fo76/comments/xvp0w7/unlock_your_heateater_power_armor_today/

To redeem you can use this website: https://www.doritosrockstarenergy.com/home

**Update 11/17/2022**: Some new codes were shared via Twitter yesterday. You can find them in the gallery below.
